text.body: śrīrāma uvāca | yathā cittacamatkṛtyā rājño gaṅgāvatāraṇam | bhagīrathasya saṃpannaṃ tanme kathaya bho prabho || 1 śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca | āsīdbhagīratho nāma rājā paramadhārmikaḥ | bhuvaḥ samudrayuktāyā maṇḍalītilakopamaḥ || 2 saṃkalpānantaraṃ prāptā yathābhimatamarthinaḥ | candraprasannavadanādasmāccintāmaṇeriva || 3 sādhūnāṃ yo vyavasthārthaṃ dhanānyavirataṃ dadau | tṛṇamātramupādatte kvaciccintāmaṇiryathā || 4 vajrasāramiva protamujvalannemi yo'bhinat | adho maṇirayoyantraṃ sarvadurjanaceṣṭitam || 5 adhūmavahnidehaśrīḥ śrānto'pi dainyamapyalam | tamo'harannṛṇāṃ naiśaṃ dyumaṇirveśmanāmiva || 6 kirannagnikaṇāsāramabhitaḥ svapratāpajam | | madhyāhnasūryakāntāgniriva jvalati yo'riṣu || 7 mṛduśītalasaṃsparśo yaḥ samāhlādayanmanaḥ | sujñānāṃ dravati snigdhasyendorindumaṇiryathā || 8 jagadyajñopavītasya svargapātālavāhinaḥ | gaṅgāvāhasya yenāsyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pūrito guṇaḥ || 9 agastyaśoṣito'mbhodhirgaṅgāpūreṇa pūritaḥ | yena duṣpūrabhūto'pi mahāsārtho'rthināmiva || 6.1.74.10 gaṅgāsopānapaddhatyā yena pātālavāsinaḥ | yojitā brahmaṇo loke bāndhavā lokabandhunā || 11 brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ jahnuṃ tapasārādhayaṃśca yaḥ | bhūyobhūyo yayau khedamaśūnyādhyavasāyinaḥ || 12 yauvane vartamānasya tasya bhūmipaterapi | pravicārayato lokayātrāṃ paryākulāmimām || 13 suvirāgacamatkāravicārakaṇikodabhūt | vayasyapi ca tāruṇye daivādvallī marāviva || 14 ekānte cintayāmāsa mahīpatirasāviti | jagadyātrāmimāṃ nityamasamañjasamākulam || 15 punardinaṃ punaḥ śyāmā dānādānaśataṃ punaḥ | tadeva bhuktavirasaṃ lakṣyate karma kurvatām || 16 yena prāptena loke'sminna prāpyamavaśiṣyate | tatkṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ manye śeṣaṃ karma viṣūcikā || 17 punaḥpunaḥ paryuṣitaṃ karma kurvanna lajjate | mūḍhbuddhirabuddhistu kaḥ kuryātkila bālavat || 18 athaikadodvignamanāḥ kadācittritalaṃ gurum | ekāntaṃ saṃsṛterbhītaḥ samapṛcchadbhagīrathaḥ || 19 bhagīratha uvāca | antaḥśūnyāsu suciraṃ bhramatsaṃsāravṛttiṣu | araṇyānīṣu caitāsu bhṛśaṃ khinnā vayaṃ vibho || 6.1.74.20 jarāmaraṇamohādirūpāṇāṃ bhavakāriṇām | bhagavansarvaduḥkhānāṃ kathamantaḥ prajāyate || 21 tritala uvāca | cirasāmyātmanotthena nirvibhāgavilāsinā | rājan jñeyāvabodhena pūrṇena bharitātmanā || 22 kṣīyante sarvaduḥkhāni truṭyanti granthayo'bhitaḥ | saṃśayāḥ samatāṃ yānti sarvakarmāṇi cānagha || 23 jñeyaṃ vidurathātmānaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ jñaptirūpiṇam | sa ca sarvagato nityaṃ nāstameti na codayam || 24 bhagīratha uvāca | cinmātraṃ nirguṇaṃ śāntamasti nirmalamacyutam | dehādi netaratkiṃciditi vedmi munīśvara || 25 kiṃ tatra pratipattirme sphuṭatāmeti netarā | etāvanmātrasaṃvittiḥ syāmahaṃ bhagavankatham || 26 tritala uvāca | jñānena jñeyaniṣṭhatvameti ceto hṛdambare | tataḥ sarvavapurbhūtvā bhūyo jīvo na jāyate || 27 asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu | nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu || 28 ātmano'nanyayogena tadbhāvanamanāratam | viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi || 29 adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam | etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ tadato'nyathā || 6.1.74.30 rāgadveṣakṣayākāraṃ saṃsāravyādhibheṣajam | ahaṃbhāvopaśāntau tu rājan jñānamavāpyate || 35 bhagīratha uvāca | śarīre'smiṃścirārūḍho girau taruriva svake | ahaṃbhāvo mahābhāga vada me tyajyate katham || 32 tritala uvāca | pauruṣeṇa prayatnena tyaktvā bhogaughabhāvanām | gatvā vikasitāṃ sattāmahaṃkāro vilīyate || 33 yantraṇāpañjaraṃ yāvadbhagnaṃ lajjādinākhilam | akiṃcanatvaśeṣeṇa sphuṭā tāvadahaṃkṛtiḥ || 34 sarvametaddhiyā tyaktvā yadi tiṣṭhasi niścalaḥ | tadahaṃkāravilaye tvameva paramaṃ padam || 35 śāntāśeṣaviśeṣaṇo vigatabhīḥ saṃtyaktasarvaiṣaṇo gatvānūnamakiṃcanatvamariṣu tyaktvā samagrāṃ śriyam | śāntāhaṃkṛtirastadehakalanasteṣveva bhikṣāmaṭa nmāmapyujjhitavānalaṃ yadibhavasyuccaistvamuccairasi 36 ityārṣe śrīvāsiṣṭhamahārāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye de0 mokṣopāyeṣu nirvāṇaprakaraṇe pū0 bhagīrathopadeśo nāma catuḥsaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ || 74|| pañcasaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ 75 śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca | atha tasya gurorvaktrādityākarṇya bhagīrathaḥ | manasyāhitakartavyaḥ svavyāpāraparo'bhavat || 1 tataḥ katipayeṣveva vāsareṣu gateṣu saḥ | agniṣṭomamakhaṃ cakre sarvatyāgekasiddhaye || 2 gobhūmyaśvahiraṇyādi dadau dhanamaśeṣataḥ | dvijebhyo nijabandhubhyo guṇyaguṇyavicārayan || 3 divasatrayamātreṇa sarvameva parityajan | asumātrāvaśeṣo'sāvāsīdrājā bhagīrathaḥ || 4 atha sarvārthariktaṃ tatkhinnaprakṛtipaurakam | sīmāntine tṛṇamiva rājyaṃ svamaraye dadau || 5 ākrānte dviṣatā rājye muniḥ sadmani maṇḍale | adhovāsovaśeṣo'sau nirjagāma svamaṇḍalāt || 6 yatra na jñāyate nāmnā yatra na jñāyate mukhāt | tatra grāmeṣvaraṇyeṣu dūreṣūvāsa dhairyavān || 7 ityalpenaiva kālena praśāntasakalaiṣaṇaḥ | parameṇa śamenāsāvāpa viśrāntimātmani || 8 bhramandvīpāni bhūpīṭhe kadācitkālayogataḥ | avaśaḥ śatruṇākrāntaṃ svameva prāpa tatpuram || 9 nānāgārāṃśca tatrāsau pravāhapatitāṃśca tān | paurāṃśca mantriṇaścaiva śamī bhikṣāmayācata || 6.1.75.10 vividuste nṛpaṃ paurā mantriṇaśca bhagīratham | pūjayāmāsuratha taṃ saviṣādāḥ saparyayā || 11 prabho rājyaṃ gṛhāṇeti prārthito'pyariṇā muniḥ | nādatte'nādṛtāśeṣastṛṇamapyaśanādṛte || 12 katiciddivasāṃstatra nītvā'nyatra jagāma saḥ | bhagīratho'yaṃ hā kaṣṭamiti lokena śocitaḥ || 13 athānyatropaśāntātmā pariviśrāntadhīḥ sukhī | ātmārāmaṃ kadācittu sa prāpa tritalaṃ gurum || 14 svameva svāgataṃ kṛtvā tena sārdhaṃ bhagīrathaḥ | kaṃcitkālamuvāsādrau vane grāme pure jane || 15 samatāmupayātau tau guruśiṣyau samau sthitau | kalayāmāsatuḥ svasthau vinodaṃ dehadhāraṇam 16 kimayaṃ dhāryate dehaḥ kiṃ vānenojjhitena naḥ | yathākramaṃ yathācāraṃ tiṣṭhatveṣa yathāsthitam || 17 iti niścitya tiṣṭhantau tau vanādvanagāminau | anānandaṃ parānandaṃ nāsukhaṃ na ca madhyamam || 18 dhanāni vājivibhavādyaiśvaryaṃ cāṣṭadhoditam | siddhairapyarpitaṃ tuṣṭairmenāte jarjaraṃ tṛṇam || 19 svakarmaṇaiva deho'yaṃ yāvatsattvamanicchayā | dhāraṇīya iti svena karmaṇaivātha tasthatuḥ || 6.1.75.20 abhinanandaturāgatamuttamau nijasamācaraṇakramajaṃ munī | sukhamasaukhyamabhīpsitavarjitau samasame'tisamau śaminau svataḥ || 21 ityārṣe śrīvāsiṣṭhamahārāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye de0 mokṣopāyeṣu nirvāṇaprakaraṇe pū0 bhagīrathanirvāṇaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamaḥ sarga ||75|| ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ 76 śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca | athaikadā pure śreṣṭhe kasmiṃścinmaṇḍalāntare | anapatye nṛpaṃ mṛtyurahanmatsya ivāmiṣam || 1 tatra prakṛtayaḥ khinnā naṣṭadeśakramā nṛpam | anviṣyanti sma saṃyuktaṃ guṇalakṣmyā viśālayā || 2 taṃ bhagīrathamāsādya sthiraṃ bhikṣācaraṃ munim | parijñāya samānīya sainye cakrurmahīpatim || 3 bhagīrathaḥ kṣaṇenaiva prāvṛṣīvāmbunā saraḥ | valitaḥ senayā gurvyā jhaṭityāśiśriye gajam || 4 bhagīratho jagannātho jayatīti janāravaiḥ | nīrandhratāmupājagmurgirīndrāṇāṃ mahāguhā || 5 tatra taṃ pālayantaṃ tadrājyaṃ rājānamādṛtāḥ | ājagmuḥ prākprakṛtayaḥ prāhuritthaṃ nṛpādhipam || 6 prakṛtaya ūcuḥ | rājannasmākamadhipo yastvayā sa puraskṛtaḥ | mṛtyunā vinigīrṇo'sau matsyenevāmiṣaṃ mṛdu || 7 tattatpālayituṃ rājyaṃ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi | aprārthitopayātānāṃ tyāgo'rthānāṃ ca nocitaḥ || 8 śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca | iti saṃprārthito rājā tadaṅgīkṛtya tadvacaḥ | saptasāgaracihnāyāḥ sa babhūva bhuvaḥ patiḥ || 9 samaḥ śāntamanā maunī vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ | prāptakāryaikakaraṇaḥ sa tirohitavismaya || 6.1.76.10 pātālatalanaṣṭānāṃ sāgarākārakāriṇām | pitāmahānāṃ gaṅgāmbu śuśruve tāraṇakṣamam || 11 tadā kila svarganadī vahati sma na bhūtale | pitṝṇāṃ bhūtavikhyo'bhūttena gaṅgājalāñjaliḥ || 12 bhagīrathena ca mahīmavatārayituṃ divaḥ | gaṅgāṃ gṛhīto niyamastataḥprabhṛti bhūbhṛtā || 13 tato rājyaṃ parityajya mantriṇāṃ bhūpatiḥ śamī | tapase kāryakāryeho jagāma vijanaṃ vanam || 14 tatra varṣasahasraiśca samārādhya punaḥpunaḥ | brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ jahnuṃ bhuvi gaṅgāmayojayat || 15 tataḥ prabhṛtyamalataraṅgabhaṅginī jagatpateḥ śaśivibhṛdaṅgasaṅginī | nabhastalānnipatati gāṃ trimārgagā mahātmanāmiva bahupuṇyasaṃtatiḥ || 16 sphurattaraṅgabhaṅginī svaphenapuñjahāsinī prasannapuṇyamañjarīyuteva dharmasaṃtatiḥ | bhagīrathe mahīpatau yaśaḥpracāravīthikā tadā hi sā trimārgagā mahītale babhūva ha 17 ityārṣe śrīvāsiṣṭhamahārāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye de0 mokṣopāyeṣu nirvāṇaprakaraṇe pū0 gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ || 76 ||
